first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: A large double-barreled firearm operated by an armored figure in the lower part of the image, featuring a blocky gun body, a support underneath, and a curved, wide segmented belt-like structure.

entities.name: Snow-Covered Rocky Battlefield
entities.identification: A ground surface composed of dark broken rocks, fractured rock slabs, undulating rocky ridges, and discontinuous white snow cover.

entities.name: Upper Smoke-Cloud Background
entities.identification: The dark blue-gray background in the upper part of the image and the yellow-brown and gray-black smoke-dust obscuring it.

entities.name: Red-Glowing Mechanical Group
entities.identification: A group of dark mechanical humanoids in the mid-to-far ground, some members of which have red glowing points on their upper bodies; it does not include the foreground figure operating Weapon A or the gun-wielding figure on the left.

entities.name: Red Glowing Projectile Trajectory
entities.identification: Bright red glowing trails crossing the battlefield horizontally or diagonally.
